title: Heat Pump
description: Clock-synced sidechain ducking: hold + log release
text:
Heat Pump is a clock-synced sidechain ducking envelope: on each division the CV ducks, holds briefly, then recovers with a logarithmic release. Patch CV Out to a filter or VCA; MIDI CC mirrors when Out is enabled.

Main sets release speed. Shift + fader sets depth. Button + fader picks clock division. Short tap triggers one manual duck. Long press mutes without snapping to idle. Shift + long toggles invert.

channels.jackDescription: CV Out = duck envelope; CV In modulates Depth, Release, or triggers Duck.

title: Grooves
description: Multi-genre MIDI drum grooves with feel
text: Grooves is a one-channel multi-genre drum helper with up to seven MIDI voices clock-synced in 4/4. **Groove** picks the genre family; **Density** and **Feel** shape fills and character; **Drummer** personas (long press) change ornament style. Swing depth is capped by **Swing max %** (sign = direction). Jack modes include Any/Stacked CV out and CV in for Density, Feel, or Reset. Clock-driven scheduling stays in a dedicated processor; MIDI sends run in a separate task (`pending_*` isolation).

channels.jackDescription: Any: velocity-weighted pulse per hit. Stacked: 1 V kick, 2 V snare, 4 V hats.
channels.faderDescription: Reveals extra drum hits as ghosts.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Short: reverse swing. Long: Any vs Stacked.

title: Umbra
description: Bass shadow companion to Contura — root/5th/approach lines over shared 12-TET scale sets, anchored to the device tonic
text:
Bass shadow companion to Contura: independent root/5th/approach phrases over
the same selectable 12-TET pitch-class sets, anchored to the device quantizer tonic.
No runtime coupling — phrases do not sync with Contura; both apps can follow the
device tonic and scale so they stay in the same key without sharing phrase length
or contour.

Pitch stays in a low register (Base Note default ~36, C2) with a hard fold within
Base±1 octave. The interval fader controls **wander** — how far each step may
drift from the root (tight root/5th at the bottom, wider bass motion at the top).
**BassFeel** per scale set shapes root bias, approach weight, ghost density and
octave-punch; there are no voice personas. Brief bass ornaments — diatonic
approaches, ghost neighbours and octave-punch — come from BassFeel and phrase
position, not from Contura's contour ornament module.

**Hybrid density** mixes Contura-style rests at low settings with ghost approach
notes from mid upward. Phrase length uses the same latch shell as Contura but
runs on its own counter.

Scale-set names are conventional labels for interval patterns (Western modes
and other named collections on equal footing). They are not claims about living
musical practice or authentic intonation.

Needs a running clock. Jack = CV Out (pitch, 1V/oct) or CV In (Density /
Interval / Reset / Phrase + CV Att), set in the Configurator. CV on Phrase
stretches and shortens the bass line independently of Contura. Gates via MIDI
note on/off. Shift+Short toggles octave span 1→2 (not Contura's 1→4).

**Follow device tonic** (default on) transposes with the device Tonic like Contura.
**Follow device scale** (default off) swaps the Scale set for the device Scale.

**Contura** (app 113) is the melodic contour line above — pair them on adjacent
channels for shadow-and-light, or run either app alone.

channels.jackDescription: CV Out: quantized bass pitch (1V/oct / range). CV In: modulates Density, Interval or Phrase, or Reset (gate) — Dest + Att in Configurator. Gate is MIDI note on/off.
channels.faderDescription: Wander budget from the root — bottom stays on root/5th, mid opens diatonic approaches, top allows wider distance-from-root motion within the octave span
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: How many steps before the bass line resets (3–28); independent from Contura's phrase clock
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Hybrid note rate — sparse rests ↔ continuous; mid and up add ghost approach notes between main hits
channels.fnDescription: Short press mutes/unmutes. Long press steps to the next scale set.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift+Short = octave span 1→2 · Shift+Long = previous scale set
channels.ledBottom: Pitch height within the current span
